registered_results.cubic_support: The formal six-neighbour result agrees exactly with the NIST simple-cubic packing row.
registered_results.hydrogen_gross_ratios: Using the NIST hydrogen ionization wavenumber only as the dimensionful input carrier, the sealed exact ratios three-quarters and five-thirty-sixths predict intervals overlapping the complete reported Lyman-alpha and Balmer-alpha intervals.
registered_results.molecular_hierarchy: The NIST H2 values confirm electronic above vibrational above rotational scales but reject a universal equality of rotational and vibrational quarter-supports or a universal two-to-one electronic/molecular numerical ratio; the leading formal receipt is retained and a versioned successor is mandatory.

validation_boundary: All source values are external observation records. They never enter the formal atomic candidate censuses. Comparison execution receives only the registered input carrier and sealed Fold ratios; withheld line targets and the unfavorable molecular ratio are released after the prediction seal.
